package answer

import (
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	"testing"
	"time"

	"github.com/example/ms-student-service/internal/domain"
)

type frozenAssignmentStub struct {
	task  *TaskMetadata
	calls int
}

func (s *frozenAssignmentStub) ResolveAssessmentTask(context.Context, string, string, string, string) (*TaskMetadata, error) {
	s.calls++
	return s.task, nil
}

func TestCorrelatedStartUsesFrozenAssignmentWithoutCourseLookup(t *testing.T) {
	task := &TaskMetadata{ID: "33333333-3333-4333-8333-333333333333", LessonID: "lesson", Status: domain.TaskStatusActive, Type: 11, SubmissionMode: taskSubmissionAnswerPayload, EvaluationMode: taskEvaluationAuto, CompletionFactType: "quiz_passed", CompletionSourceRevisionID: "revision", CodeStructure: json.RawMessage(`{"expected_answers":["old answer"]}`)}
	resolver := &frozenAssignmentStub{task: task}
	lifecycle := &learningActionLifecycleStub{}
	output, err := (StartTaskAnswer{LessonAssignments: resolver, LearningActions: lifecycle}).Handle(context.Background(), StartTaskAnswerInput{StudentID: "44444444-4444-4444-8444-444444444444", TaskID: "33333333-3333-4333-8333-333333333333", LearningPathItemID: "11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111", RequirementID: "22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222"})
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if output.AnswerID == "" || resolver.calls != 1 {
		t.Fatalf("frozen assignment was not used: %+v", output)
	}
}

func TestCorrelatedAnswerScoringRemainsPinnedAfterCourseChange(t *testing.T) {
	task := &TaskMetadata{ID: "33333333-3333-4333-8333-333333333333", Status: domain.TaskStatusActive, Type: 12, SubmissionMode: taskSubmissionAnswerPayload, EvaluationMode: taskEvaluationAuto, Tests: []TaskTestMetadata{{ID: "question", Kind: "ordering", Variants: []TaskTestVariantMetadata{{ID: "b", CorrectOrder: frozenAssessmentIntPtr(1)}, {ID: "a", CorrectOrder: frozenAssessmentIntPtr(2)}}}}}
	frozen, err := json.Marshal(task)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	attempt := &domain.StudentTaskAnswer{ID: "55555555-5555-4555-8555-555555555555", StudentID: "44444444-4444-4444-8444-444444444444", TaskID: "33333333-3333-4333-8333-333333333333", Status: domain.StudentTaskAnswerStatusInProgress, LearningPathItemID: "item", RequirementID: "requirement", FrozenTaskJSON: frozen}
	repo := &taskAnswerGuardRepoStub{answers: map[string]*domain.StudentTaskAnswer{"55555555-5555-4555-8555-555555555555": attempt}}
	// No provider is configured: a mutable metadata lookup would fail or panic.
	selections := &assessmentVariantRepoStub{}
	lifecycle := &learningActionLifecycleStub{active: domain.StudentLearningAction{ID: "11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111", StudentTaskAnswerID: "55555555-5555-4555-8555-555555555555", StudentID: "44444444-4444-4444-8444-444444444444", TaskID: "33333333-3333-4333-8333-333333333333", Cycle: 1, OpenedAt: time.Now(), EvidenceClass: domain.LearningEvidenceKnowledgeCheck, ContextType: domain.LearningContextLessonTask, ContextID: "33333333-3333-4333-8333-333333333333"}}
	err = (FinalValidation{Answers: repo, TaskTestAnswers: selections, LearningActions: lifecycle}).Handle(context.Background(), "55555555-5555-4555-8555-555555555555", json.RawMessage(`{"answers":[{"test_id":"question","ordered_variant_ids":["b","a"]}]}`))
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if lifecycle.closedAction.Outcome != domain.LearningActionPassed {
		t.Fatalf("pinned answer did not pass: %+v", lifecycle.closedAction)
	}
}

func TestMissingFrozenSnapshotFailsClosed(t *testing.T) {
	attempt := &domain.StudentTaskAnswer{TaskID: "33333333-3333-4333-8333-333333333333", LearningPathItemID: "item", RequirementID: "requirement"}
	if _, err := taskForAnswer(context.Background(), progressionTaskProviderStub{tasks: map[string]*TaskMetadata{"33333333-3333-4333-8333-333333333333": {ID: "33333333-3333-4333-8333-333333333333"}}}, attempt); err != domain.ErrValidation {
		t.Fatalf("got %v, want validation error", err)
	}
}

func TestPartialAssessmentCorrelationRejected(t *testing.T) {
	_, err := (StartTaskAnswer{}).Handle(context.Background(), StartTaskAnswerInput{LearningPathItemID: "11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111"})
	if err != domain.ErrValidation {
		t.Fatalf("got %v, want validation error", err)
	}
}

func frozenAssessmentIntPtr(v int) *int { return &v }
